title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 6 Game-Day Availability + Depth Roles
scope: Attach exact ESPN depth roles and exact-event game-day availability states to the frozen Step 5 two-source verified QB/RB/WR/TE identities. PENDING remains PENDING before final inactive reporting; exact-event unavailable status overrides depth. No props, odds, projections, Passing Yards changes, or existing NFL market changes.

required: frozen Step 5 exact ESPN athlete id
exact ESPN event id resolved by date + away/home matchup

availability_contract.event_resolution: Resolve ESPN event independently from target date + away/home matchup; do not assume the frozen Step 3 game_id is an ESPN event id.
availability_contract.pregame_pending_rule: PENDING is valid truth before final inactive reporting, but no unlisted player may be called AVAILABLE.
availability_contract.confirmed_rule: Only CONFIRMED final inactive reporting may label an unlisted Step 5 player GAME-DAY AVAILABLE.
availability_contract.unavailable_override: Exact-event OUT/INACTIVE/unavailable status overrides depth role and marks the player UNAVAILABLE.
availability_contract.unverified_rule: UNVERIFIED event provider fails Step 6 closed.

depth_contract.identity_join: Exact Step 5 ESPN athlete id only
depth_contract.role_rule: Depth rank 1 = position starter; rank >1 = depth; unmatched IDs remain depth-unverified.
depth_contract.live_gate: Both teams require at least one exact-ID depth-verified player in QB/RB/WR/TE.

acceptance: Step 6 consumes only Step 5 two-source verified player identities; it does not create new players.
ESPN event identity is independently resolved by target date + away/home matchup before exact-event availability is requested.
PENDING pregame availability renders as PENDING and cannot be promoted to AVAILABLE.
Exact-event unavailable status overrides any depth role for that exact player ID/name.
Only CONFIRMED final inactive reporting may label an otherwise eligible player GAME-DAY AVAILABLE.
Depth roles attach only by exact Step 5 ESPN athlete ID and expose depth rank/source.
Both teams have exact-ID depth evidence in QB/RB/WR/TE or Step 6 fails closed.
Step 5 product module and ledger remain byte-identical.
390/768/1440 Step 6 overlay has no horizontal overflow.
Public production proof passes before Step 6 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
next_step_after_freeze: Step 7 — Eligible Player Selection + Prop Page Handoff
